text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Alright, one more lap...
Just like Trainer said, this time I'll focus on my form—)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me!
Zenno Rob Roy, do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Eh, ah, yes...!
U-Um... what is it...?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Um, would you run alongside me?
Over a long distance, if possible...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...! If you're really okay with me, I'd love to...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, haaah... phew...
Th-Thank you very much...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Haa...! Haa... haa...!
In the second half, I completely...
got left in the dust, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Phew, I need to rethink my endurance training.
Rob Roy-san really is amazing after all...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Yes! She has way too much stamina...!
I knew that already, but running alongside her,
it's even more than I imagined!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, as expected of Rob Roy-san!
My rival is so strong...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I might've lost today,
but when it comes to racing, I won't give an inch either!
Well then, thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(I really have gotten stronger...!
Even during that tandem run just now, I felt like I had plenty left in the tank.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (It's all thanks to the training menu Trainer put together for me...!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I have to report to Trainer right away...!
Ehehe...!

Zenno Rob Roy savored the joy
of feeling her abilities grow.
